purpose: Phase 3 — In-Range Refresh verification (Task 4). The w3 Red-phase TDD suite asserts this fixture exists, carries the four required quality-gate categories (npm_ls, npm_audit, boundary_check, per_app_quality_gates), and pins 0 critical / 0 high with force_fix_used=false. Green behavior: a w3 Green commit runs the actual quality-gate commands post-refresh and writes their post-W3 results here so a future wave (P4/P5) can re-verify AC8 (full quality gate passes).

npm_ls.summary: Clean. No dependency-tree problems across the 5 apps and 19 active shared packages (24 active workspace manifests; 1 _template excluded). Post-W3 invariant.

npm_audit.summary: 0 critical / 0 high; 14 moderate (all transitive) dispositioned in w3-advisory-disposition.json. 13 deferred to W4 framework majors, 1 rejected (drizzle-kit downgrade per FR9).

boundary_check.summary: No monorepo boundary violations after W3 refresh.

per_app_quality_gates.purpose: Per-app lint/test/typecheck/build status captured after W3 refresh. Each app's CI scripts are run; results are recorded so a wave that flips a previously-green app to red is attributable to that wave.

single_root_lockfile_invariant.purpose: Cross-check the npm ls result against the filesystem: exactly one package-lock.json at the repo root, zero nested. See also lockfile-inventory.json (AC7, FR10).

pre_existing_failures.policy: Per spec Out-of-Scope, pre-existing failures unrelated to the upgrade are not auto-fixed; they are recorded here for attribution. If a wave resolves one of these as a side effect, mark it resolved with the wave SHA.
